title: The Critical State of Cyberspacs
description: <p>NATO is currently in a ‘grey zone’: increasingly being challenged in cyberspace while unable to attribute attacks, thus failing to deter. Simultaneously, many governments, businesses, and populations depend on the Internet and the cloud to function properly. This is a dangerous situation, since global Internet connectivity could get disrupted and destabilised. This chapter explains the basic principles from an overall technological perspective, and discusses the challenge of anti-access
